description: Terminal-Bench style config audit: turn a site dhcpd.conf (7 host reservations with fixed-prefix6 /64s, a group pool and a shared-network pool) into the six inventory numbers the gate re-derives from the file with ipaddress arithmetic.

criteria: All six inventory numbers match the dhcpd.conf (commented-out blocks excluded, both range endpoints counted) and the configuration, the docs and the gate are untouched.
